test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What percentage of 1.5 lakh post offices is expected to come under the core banking system in year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Union budget 2022-23 announcement is made on ‘Anytime-Anywhere post office savings’ that aims to cover all the post offices in the country with a core banking system to help access accounts through internet banking, mobile banking, and ATMs.
 
• 1.5 lakh post offices will come 100% on the core banking system (CBS)enabling financial inclusion and access to accounts through net banking, mobile banking, ATMs, and also providing online transfer of funds between post office accounts and bank accounts.
 
• This will be helpful, especially for farmers and senior citizens in rural areas, enabling interoperability and financial inclusion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__Post Budget Webinar on “Leaving No Citizen Behind” was organized on February 23, 2022. 
 
• This initiative was chaired by the Minister of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj, Shri Giriraj Singh.
